audit: 2026-09-08 scheduled remote agent p1: 50 Qs in one batch across all four topics (Medicine 14, Psychiatry 13, Obstetrics and Gynaecology 13, Paediatrics 10), published as ten 5-question files to stay inside the tool payload limit. Per-question deficit selection was run on the active L3-L5 tier because the closed legacy L2 inventory of about 27 to 30 per cent per topic makes the whole-topic denominator unreachable. Every topic entered the run at 49.1 to 49.2 per cent L3, 44.2 to 44.3 per cent L4 and 6.5 to 6.6 per cent L5, so L5 sat above its 5 per cent target in all four topics and none was generated; L3 was marginally the most deficient cell everywhere with L4 next, giving 29 L3 and 21 L4 and zero L2. Within-topic proportions were within 0.2 percentage points of each other across all four modules, so the module balance rule broke the tie and the lowest count module took 14 while the highest count module took 10. Correct-letter distribution A10 B10 C10 D10 E10; worst option length parity 1.19 across all 50 with the correct option the longest in only 10; zero non-ASCII characters, zero em-dashes and zero banned tokens; every rationale carries an inline source and every source_ref matches a label in that question sources array; no stem or id duplicates against the existing bank; every stem positions the candidate as the treating doctor; no lead-in guideline leaks, no pertinent-negative parentheticals in any correct option and no pile-ups beyond two closures per stem.
